verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 5.1 Key performance indicators table and surrounding text; Consolidated Financial Statements

candidate_sentences.text: For the financial year ended 31 December 2025, AS Tallinna Sadam Group reported revenue of EUR 118.7 million, representing a slight decrease of 0.8 percent or EUR 0.9 million compared to EUR 119.6 million in 2024.

Adjusted EBITDA grew by 6.4 percent or EUR 3.4 million to EUR 56.5 million, up from EUR 53.1 million in 2024, resulting in an improved adjusted EBITDA margin of 47.6 percent compared to 44.4 percent previously.
Profit for the period rose by 17.3 percent or EUR 3.3 million to EUR 22.5 million, compared to EUR 19.2 million in 2024.
Total assets at period-end stood at EUR 622.1 million, down by 1.2 percent from EUR 629.9 million, while total equity increased by 0.9 percent to EUR 380.9 million.
Net debt decreased significantly by 15.5 percent to EUR 141.7 million, down from EUR 167.6 million at the end of 2024.
Capital investments for the year were EUR 33.2 million, representing a 14.4 percent decrease compared to EUR 38.8 million in the prior year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Passenger business growth with 8.3 million passengers (+1.0% YoY), dominated by Tallinn-Helsinki route (+1% passengers), and cruise tourism recovery featuring 190 thousand cruise passengers (+25%) and 118 calls (+18), offset by Tallinn-Stockholm decline.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.4 Market overview: passengers and 5.6.1 Number of passengers

candidate_sentences.text: Operating volumes showed positive developments in several areas, with cargo volumes increasing by 5.1 percent to 13.8 million tonnes and the number of passengers rising by 1.0 percent to 8.3 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Cargo volume recovery to 13.8 million tonnes (+5.1% YoY) driven by liquid bulk surge (+47%, led by ligroin and gasoline), transit goods growth (+75%), and dry bulk increase, partially offset by ro-ro and container declines.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.5 Market overview: cargo and 5.6.2 Cargo volume

verified_key_information_units.information: Major strategic infrastructure investments including completion of multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour, Muuga Harbour quay reinforcement for large vessels, and ongoing design work for Old City Harbour Terminal A and shore power capacity.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 5.10 Investments and development prospects

verified_key_information_units.information: Dividend distribution of EUR 19.199 million (EUR 0.073 per share) representing 100% of prior year profit, aligned with policy, accompanied by share price appreciation to EUR 1.296 (+22.7%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.11 Dividends and 5.12 Share and shareholders

candidate_sentences.text: Based on the financial results and dividend policy, the management board proposed a dividend distribution of EUR 0.073 per share, totaling EUR 19.2 million, matching the total dividend paid out in the previous year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Adverse impact of Russia-Ukraine war reducing liquid bulk volumes and eliminating St. Petersburg cruise calls, partially mitigated by winter cruise season extension, regional marketing, and economic recovery in Estonia and Nordic partners.

verified_key_information_units.information: Icebreaker Botnica operated at reduced utilization rate (49%) with lower charter revenue, but participated in international rescue operations for cargo ship MV Thamesborg in Canadian Arctic waters.
